visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder blouse and dark denim trousers, stands in a studio setting. She holds a silver transverse flute to her lips, with her fingers positioned accurately on the keys. Her facial expression is calm and focused as she prepares to play. The background is a smooth gradient of pink and deep blue with soft lighting. (2) She begins playing the flute, her fingers moving with rhythm and precision. The camera remains static in a medium shot, capturing her upper body. Bright yellow and white text overlays appear at the top, and a white musical staff with scrolling notes is fixed at the bottom. She maintains steady eye contact with the camera while performing. (3) The studio lighting shifts slightly, emphasizing the purple and blue tones in the background. The woman continues to play the flute with an energetic and expressive posture. Various lines of text in Chinese, Japanese, and English cycle through the top and middle sections of the screen, providing clues and context about the song. (4) In the final phase, she finishes the musical passage, lowers the flute slightly from her mouth, and smiles warmly at the camera. A small logo appears briefly as she maintains her pose against the vibrant gradient background, concluding the performance with a friendly and inviting look.
